# AI/ML Learning Notes {.unnumbered}

These are my working notes on modern AI, machine learning, generative AI, NLP,
computer vision, IoT, graph ML, MLOps, and ML system design — written as I learn,
from foundations upward.

The goal of this book is depth through rebuilding: every concept is traced back
to the foundations it stands on, then rebuilt forward with math, code, and
practical trade-offs.

## How to read this book

- **Chapters** follow the skill categories on my
  [AI/ML Learning Tracker](https://ramanaai.com/learning-tracker.htm).
- **Math** is typeset with LaTeX: inline like $h_t = f(Wx_t + Uh_{t-1} + b)$,
  or displayed:

$$\attention(Q, K, V) = \softmax\!\left(\frac{QK^\top}{\sqrt{d_k}}\right)V$$

- **Code** is runnable and reproducible where possible.
- **Progress checkboxes** on the website tracker sync with what is covered here.

::: {.callout-note}
This is a living document. Chapters are added as learning progresses.
:::

## Conventions

- Vectors are bold lowercase ($\mathbf{x}$), matrices bold uppercase ($W$).
- $\R$ denotes the real numbers, $\E[\cdot]$ expectation.
- Code examples use Python unless stated otherwise.
